key.name: api-key
key.description: Your Z.ai Bearer token (the same key used for the GLM API). Leave empty to read ZAI_API_KEY from the environment.

key.name: use-env-key
key.summary: Fall back to ZAI_API_KEY env var
key.description: When no API key is set in preferences, read it from the ZAI_API_KEY environment variable if present.

key.name: plan-label
key.description: Short label shown in the panel (e.g. GLM, Coding, GLM-5.2).

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Display the GLM icon in the panel.

key.name: panel-gauge
key.description: Which usage gauge to draw in the panel: a circular ring, a horizontal bar, or none.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Display the usage percentage number in the panel.

key.name: show-reset
key.description: Display, in the panel, the time left before the token quota resets.

key.name: show-remaining
key.description: Display the remaining percentage rather than the used percentage everywhere.

key.name: window-hours
key.description: Length of the rolling quota window in hours, used only for the burn-rate projection. The percentage and reset countdown do not depend on this.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to poll for updated usage.
